title: Independently verify privately published Codecs and exact IR/Quantities binary closure
commitMessage: test: independently verify published Codecs IR and Quantities NuGet binaries

contribution.summary: Independently qualify the owner-published immutable Codecs archive and its exact IR/Quantities dependency closure from physical NUGET_LOCAL readback and fifteen compiled package-only binary probes. RS163 never publishes.
contribution.value: Verify three original private archives and embedded DLL hashes, exact direct IR and transitive Quantities dependencies, restore an isolated Codecs PackageReference consumer from a disposable snapshot, and prove shared-feed archives unchanged.
debtChanges: RS162 completed first-pass publisher rehearsal on a disposable feed. It did not establish actual private Codecs publication, which is a separately authorized owner action.
RS163 requires the original RS161 Codecs archive to be physically present in NUGET_LOCAL with its exact qualified 35096-byte SHA. It refuses an absent or altered package.
Independent physical verification cannot claim public licensing, installed rollback, other OS support, cross-repository migration or broad feed certification.
contribution.nextAction: After RS163 passes with physical feed evidence, select a next unpublished Math package for bounded qualification. Preserve owner-only publication and independent readback gates.
